sections.title: Transcription
sections.summary: Twenty-eight verified source packets with exact release assets, 45-prompt workflows, and public readback.
limitations: Packet PASS does not certify a completed transcription or edition.
Seventeen later staging successors are excluded until their own independent admission checks pass.

sections.title: Translation
sections.summary: Subject-organized work and language coverage with a local/web chooser and source-preflight workflow.
limitations: The starter contains no textbook and no completed translation.
Most catalog rows require independent source, license, component, and baseline-build preflight.

sections.title: Open problems
sections.summary: Workbench v0.2 contains candidate statements, review queues, literature queries, source-list imports, scripts, schemas, and templates.
limitations: No problem record is yet admitted as a canonical runnable packet.
Internal package PASS does not establish canonical wording, current status, complete literature, or a proof.
